title: A tail in motion
hook: A moving body must remain balanced.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Describe the balancing role of a kangaroo tail.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Describe the balancing role of a kangaroo tail.

claims.text: During a kangaroo’s hopping, what role can its tail contribute? The diagram makes the extended tail visible behind the body during a hop. It can contribute to balance as the body moves. This sketch is not a measurement of the forces, and kangaroos use the tail in other ways during slower movement.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, kangaroo, https://animals.sandiegozoo.org/animals/kangaroo

claims.text: The diagram and its labels are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. Hopping animal · schematic
A kangaroo shifts its body as it hops. Which structure can help counterbalance its motion? A kangaroo’s tail contributes to balance during hopping.
